relations.subject: P. S. Subrahmanya Sastri
relations.evidence: Subrahmanya Sastri did his S.S.L.C. at National High School, F.A. at St. Joseph's College and B.A. Mathematics at SPG (later Bishop Heber's) College – all in Tiruchirappalli.

relations.subject: P. S. Subrahmanya Sastri
relations.evidence: Subrahmanya Sastri also passed L.T. through Teachers’ Training College at Saidapet, Chennai.

relations.subject: P. S. Subrahmanya Sastri
relations.evidence: Subrahmanya Sastri submitted his Ph.D. thesis, ‘History of Grammatical Theories in Tamil and their relation to grammatical literature in Sanskrit’ in 1930 at the Madras University.

relations.subject: P. S. Subrahmanya Sastri
relations.evidence: He studied Sanskrit under Nilakanta Sastri, a specialist in grammar and philosophy.

relations.subject: P. S. Subrahmanya Sastri
relations.evidence: He also learnt Nyaya (logic) and Alankara Sastra (Poetics and Literary Criticism) from Prof. S. Kuppuswami Sastri of the Madras Presidency College

relations.subject: P. S. Subrahmanya Sastri
relations.evidence: and Mimamsa (Linguistics) from Chinnaswami Sastri of the Benares Hindu University.

relations.subject: S. Kuppuswami Sastri
relations.role: Professor of Sanskrit and comparative philology
relations.evidence: Prof. S. Kuppuswami Sastri of the Madras Presidency College (professor of Sanskrit and comparative philology, and curator of the Government Oriental Manuscripts Library, Madras)

relations.subject: S. Kuppuswami Sastri
relations.evidence: and curator of the Government Oriental Manuscripts Library, Madras

relations.subject: Chinnaswami Sastri
relations.evidence: Chinnaswami Sastri of the Benares Hindu University.

relations.subject: P. S. Subrahmanya Sastri
relations.evidence: Subrahmanya Sastri was appointed Professor of Oriental Studies at SPG College, Tiruchi, by Fr. Gardiner in 1917 and served his alma mater till 1926.

relations.subject: P. S. Subrahmanya Sastri
relations.evidence: He then became the Asst. Editor, Tamil Lexicon, University of Madras, in which capacity he served till 1932 and editor of the Lexicon for a month.

relations.subject: P. S. Subrahmanya Sastri
relations.evidence: He was principal, Rajah's College, Thiruvaiyaru (1932-1942)

relations.subject: P. S. Subrahmanya Sastri
relations.role: Head of the Department of Sanskrit
relations.evidence: and Head of the Department of Sanskrit at the Annamalai University (1942–1947).

relations.subject: Thomas T. Burrow
relations.evidence: Mr. Thomas T. Burrow, a Sanskrit scholar from England ... took keen interest in attending his Sanskrit classes at Annamalai University.

relations.subject: Thomas T. Burrow
relations.evidence: (later Boden Professor of Sanskrit at the Oxford University and the joint author of the epoch making Dravidian Etymological Dictionary)
